components.name: calc_cure_power

    mov eax, dword ptr [0x00687FA8]
    mov ecx, dword ptr [eax + 0x13D8]
    imul ecx, dword ptr [ebp + 0x10]
    mov edx, dword ptr [ebp + 0x0C]
    mov esi, dword ptr [eax + edx * 4 + 0x13DC]
    add esi, ecx
    mov ecx, dword ptr [ebp + 0x14]
    test ecx, ecx
    jz calc_done
    push esi
    mov eax, dword ptr [ebp + 0x08]
    push dword ptr [eax + 0x78]
    push 0x25
    mov eax, 0x4e6260
    call eax
    add esi, eax
calc_done:
    mov eax, esi
    pop esi
    mov esp, ebp
    pop ebp
    ret 0x10

components.name: cure_wrapper
components.assembly:
cure_wrapper:
    mov eax, dword ptr [esp + 0x0C]
    test eax, eax
    jz tail_cure
    mov edx, dword ptr [eax + 0x1A]
    cmp edx, 0x19
    je specialist
    cmp edx, 0xAA
    jne tail_cure
specialist:
    cmp dword ptr [ecx + 0x4C], 0
    jle dead_stack

live_stack:
    push ebp
    mov ebp, esp
    sub esp, 0x20
    push ebx
    push esi
    push edi
    mov esi, ecx
    mov dword ptr [ebp - 0x08], ebx
    mov eax, dword ptr [ecx + 0x4C]
    mov dword ptr [ebp - 0x10], eax
    mov eax, dword ptr [ecx + 0x60]
    mov dword ptr [ebp - 0x14], eax

    push dword ptr [ebp + 0x10]
    push dword ptr [ebp + 0x0C]
    push dword ptr [ebp + 0x08]
    mov ecx, esi
    call 0x446220
    mov dword ptr [ebp - 0x1C], eax

    test eax, eax
    jns live_finish
    mov edx, eax
    neg edx
    mov dword ptr [ebp - 0x20], edx
    mov eax, dword ptr [ebp - 0x10]
    cmp eax, dword ptr [ebp - 0x14]
    jge live_finish

    mov eax, esi
    push 0
    push dword ptr [eax + 0x38]
    mov ecx, dword ptr [ebp - 0x08]
    push dword ptr [ecx + 0x132C0]
    call 0x5a3fd0
    test eax, eax
    je live_finish
    cmp eax, esi
    jne live_finish

    push 0
    push dword ptr [ebp - 0x20]
    push eax
    mov ecx, dword ptr [ebp - 0x08]
    call 0x639cf5

live_finish:
    mov eax, dword ptr [ebp - 0x1C]
    pop edi
    pop esi
    pop ebx
    mov esp, ebp
    pop ebp
    ret 0x0C

dead_stack:
    push ebp
    mov ebp, esp
    sub esp, 0x08
    push ebx
    push esi
    push edi
    mov dword ptr [ebp - 0x04], ecx
    mov dword ptr [ebp - 0x08], ebx
    cmp dword ptr [ecx + 0x60], 0
    jle dead_finish

    push 0
    push dword ptr [ecx + 0x38]
    mov eax, dword ptr [ebp - 0x08]
    push dword ptr [eax + 0x132C0]
    mov ecx, eax
    call 0x5a3fd0
    test eax, eax
    je dead_finish
    cmp eax, dword ptr [ebp - 0x04]
    jne dead_finish

    push dword ptr [ebp + 0x10]
    push dword ptr [ebp + 0x0C]
    push dword ptr [ebp + 0x08]
    push eax
    call 0x639d80
    test eax, eax
    jle dead_finish

    push 0
    push eax
    push dword ptr [ebp - 0x04]
    mov ecx, dword ptr [ebp - 0x08]
    call 0x639cf5

dead_finish:
    xor eax, eax
    pop edi
    pop esi
    pop ebx
    mov esp, ebp
    pop ebp
    ret 0x0C

tail_cure:
    jmp 0x446220

components.name: target_resolver_gate
components.assembly:
target_resolver_gate:
    mov edx, dword ptr [ebp + 0x08]
    cmp edx, 0x25
    jne resolver_original

    push ecx
    mov eax, dword ptr [ebp + 0x10]
    lea edx, [eax * 8]
    sub edx, eax
    shl edx, 4
    lea ecx, [edx + ecx + 0x1C4]
    mov eax, 0x4e7230
    call eax
    test eax, eax
    jnz resolver_return_living
    pop ecx

    cmp dword ptr [ebp + 0x18], 0
    jne resolver_zero
    mov edx, dword ptr [ebp + 0x0C]
    cmp edx, dword ptr [ecx + 0x132C0]
    jne resolver_zero
    mov eax, dword ptr [ecx + edx * 4 + 0x53CC]
    test eax, eax
    jz resolver_zero
    mov eax, dword ptr [eax + 0x1A]
    cmp eax, 0x19
    je resolver_corpse
    cmp eax, 0xAA
    jne resolver_zero

resolver_corpse:
    push dword ptr [ebp + 0x18]
    push dword ptr [ebp + 0x10]
    push dword ptr [ebp + 0x0C]
    mov eax, 0x5a3fd0
    call eax
    pop ebp
    ret 0x14

resolver_return_living:
    add esp, 4
    pop ebp
    ret 0x14

resolver_zero:
    xor eax, eax
    pop ebp
    ret 0x14

resolver_original:
    sub edx, 0x26
    jmp 0x5a3c7d

components.name: mass_corpse_hook
components.assembly:
mass_corpse_helper:
    mov ecx, dword ptr [ebp - 0x14]
    jecxz helper_magic_return
    jmp hero_check
helper_magic_return:
    mov ecx, dword ptr [ebp + 0x10]
    pop eax
    push 0
    push eax
    ret
hero_check:
    mov eax, dword ptr [ecx + 0x1a]
    cmp al, 0x19
    je specialist
    cmp al, 0xaa
    jne helper_magic_return
specialist:
    push edi
    and dword ptr [ebp + 0x14], 0
stack_loop:
    mov edx, dword ptr [ebx + 0x132c0]
    mov eax, dword ptr [ebp + 0x14]
    cmp eax, dword ptr [ebx + edx * 4 + 0x54bc]
    jge helper_pop
    imul ecx, edx, 0x15
    add ecx, eax
    imul ecx, ecx, 0x548
    lea edi, [ebx + ecx + 0x54cc]
    cmp dword ptr [edi + 0x4c], 0
    jne stack_next
    cmp dword ptr [edi + 0x60], 0
    jle stack_next
    push 0
    push dword ptr [edi + 0x38]
    push edx
    mov ecx, ebx
    call 0x5a3fd0
    cmp eax, edi
    jne stack_next
    push dword ptr [ebp - 0x14]
    push dword ptr [ebp + 0x1c]
    push esi
    push edi
    call 0x639d80
    test eax, eax
    jle stack_next
    push 0
    push eax
    push edi
    mov ecx, ebx
    call 0x639cf5
    mov eax, dword ptr [ebx + 0x132c0]
    imul eax, eax, 0x14
    add eax, dword ptr [ebp + 0x14]
    mov byte ptr [ebx + eax + 0x547c], 1
stack_next:
    inc dword ptr [ebp + 0x14]
    jmp stack_loop
helper_pop:
    pop edi
    jmp helper_magic_return
